plain: A model design where each word is sent through only a few of many sub-networks; a dense model sends every word through all of them.
eli5: A school where each question goes to just two of many teachers, instead of every teacher answering every question.
technical: An architecture whose feed-forward blocks are many experts with a learned router choosing a small subset per token; unlike a dense transformer, the computation differs per token, which complicates analyses that assume one residual-stream picture per layer.
